mode: CPU read-only; no existing source edits, no optimizer execution or GPU rendering.
conclusion: The broad lower-body flat colour comes from zero or extremely weak BUILD colour support and a single global RGB-median fallback. The inspected I/O chain is consistent. Literal saturated white points are a separate small fitted subset.

unknown_colour.explanation: For an A-column equal tozero, the data term has no dependence on that row RGB. Positive ridge and initialization at c0 give the exact optimum RGB=c0. More colour steps or primitive subdivision cannot add observations to that column.

rendered_flat_colour_checks.normalization: Saved solo RGB divided by saved alpha; include only alpha>.5; saved images are float16.
rendered_flat_colour_checks.limitation: Colour matching is an image diagnostic, not a unique primitive-contribution decomposition. Off-visible pixels include actual occlusion, unknown surfaces and mask boundaries.

literal_white_points.meaning: These9 rows moved from coloured c0 to the bounded optimum. They have nonzero but mostly weak fit support; their row RGB is not a per-point measured colour label. They do not explain the broad constant fallback patch.

premultiplied_alpha.evidence: A=W/alpha fits straight raw RGB; native reference divided by alpha once. Saved actual render/alpha agrees with CPU A@RGB to float16 rounding.

SH_direction.interpretation: M2 has SH0 content in an SH3 storage container; view direction cannot change a zero higher-order term.

coordinate_time.evidence: All40 saved camera transforms match native camera records exactly and model_times match. Original full PVD construction checks conditioning actor-native metres. Saved render/design parity also exercises geometry/camera bindings.
coordinate_time.limit: No new physical calibration was inferred or fitted.

minimal_next_control.name: BUILD-supported appearance extension on unchanged asset
minimal_next_control.change: Replace the one global-median c0 fallback on strictly zero/weak support rows with a confidence-weighted colour extension over the fixed surface graph from reliable BUILD colour anchors. Keep geometry, N, normal, scale, opacity, known-row material, camera, masks and renderer fixed.
minimal_next_control.interpretation: This is an explicitly inferred appearance prior, not recovered hidden RGB. Keep inferred flags and compare the same fixed visible/HELD and preservation masks.
minimal_next_control.IO_action: The audit found no channel, scaling, alpha or pose correction to apply.
minimal_next_control.measurement_path: True hidden-colour accuracy requires additional verified views of the same surface. Existing visibility gates should remain when collecting such evidence.
minimal_next_control.unsupported_action: Fitting currently a37-occluded pixels to their raw image RGB would transfer the foreground actor colours to a6.

limitations: Canonical-z region cuts are transparent diagnostic geometry cuts, not semantic bumper/wheel labels.
The global fallback is blue-grey in normalized RGB, although perceived as grey/white in the rendered object.
Most nonzero lower design columns are still weak: the saved inferred flag is true for1618 of1660. No per-point true colour error is claimed from weighted image observations.
Native/PVD geometry already uses same-scene context, including old HELD conditioning. This is an I/O diagnosis rather than independent appearance generalization.
A constant SH0 prior can remain visibly featureless under this correct I/O path. This does not identify model-family capacity as the cause of zero observations.
